Simple heading followed by paragraph produces Heading and Paragraph nodes

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"include_document_structure\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<h1>Title</h1><p>A paragraph of text.</p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
